这回轮到沈珩呆愣了好几秒，最后丢下一句，【我先攒着。】才结束了视频通话。

韩小汐有点没弄明白，攒着什么？？

不过看着通话时间，四十七分钟。

天哪！

他们聊这么久？！

时间过得好快，都没发现呢！

这就是传说中的煲电话粥？！

他们这还是进阶视频版~

CCG的警察们看傻眼了，有马贵将召唤出的雷龙居然就这样被轻而易举的抓住，撕碎？

他俩还都戴着墨镜，满脸冷漠，乍一看就跟施瓦辛格演的终结者似的。

This time it was Shen Heng's turn to be stunned for several seconds, and finally said, "I'll save it first."】Just ended the video call.

Han Xiaoxi didn't understand. What were you saving??

But looking at the call time, it was forty-seven minutes.

Oh my gosh!

Did they chat for so long?!

Time flies by so fast and I didn’t notice it yet!

Is this the legendary talking on the phone?!

This is an advanced video version~

The CCG policemen were dumbfounded. The Thunder Dragon summoned by Arima Kisho was caught and torn into pieces so easily?

Both of them were wearing sunglasses and had cold faces. At first glance, they looked like the Terminator played by Schwarzenegger.
